properties.name: P1 every captured cent goes to the queuer, to PayPal or to HoldMySpot's 10%, each share from its own rule, and the processing line is PayPal's fee
P2 the captures of any split never pass the hold, receipts and labels above the caps included
P4 every completed job leaves HoldMySpot exactly floor(10% of the queue fee); a refund after the fee payout costs it that payout and PayPal's fees, no more
P2 the limit check refuses every capture past 100% of the hold, whatever PayPal's 115% would allow
P3 every forgery fails its hard check and fails the receipt; soft issues go to a person; a clean receipt passes
P3 listed price: a real receipt reprinted above the item's listed price, within the requester's cap and its QR regenerated to match, goes to a person and is never passed

P3 known limit: a receipt reprinted at a higher price that stays at or under the listed price (or, for an item with no listed price, under the cap) passes every check; the charge is the reprint's, never above the listing or the cap
P6 the step-down never rises, never goes below its floor or above its opening fee, and drops only by whole steps
P6 a resting max fills at the first step at or below it, never above it, never below the floor
P6 before check-in the clock has not started: the fee stays at the opening fee at any time
P6 every fill is at the ask's clock price now, at or under the bid's max, between compatible orders, within quantities
P6 price-time priority holds and no trade is left on the table
P6 the result does not depend on the order the book lists its orders in
P7 the highest max fee a hold covers fits that hold, and one cent more does not
P8 each capture nets exactly its base plus its payout fees after PayPal's fee, and one cent less would not
P8 the gross-up is exact for any percentage below 100% and any fixed fees, not only PayPal's current ones
P1-P4 P6 P7: any day of requests, offers, receipts and PayPal failures keeps every money and market rule
P5 the same day with lost, dropped and garbled PayPal answers ends with the same PayPal objects and amounts
P7 every option the rescheduler lists is allowed now and keeps each job on its shop and item, inside the offer's room, at or under the max fee and inside the hold
